artworks.title: Repoussée ... une porte me reste ouverte ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures in an interior setting. The person on the left is seated in a chair in a relaxed position, with their legs crossed and hands resting on their lap. Their head is slightly tilted forward. They have long hair and are dressed in a long gown. On the right, another person stands beside a table, slightly leaning forward. This person has short, curly hair and a more expressive face, pointing one finger forward. They wear a darker, more fitted dress. The table beside them has draped fabric over it. The background features walls with patterned wallpaper, a framed picture, and a curtain.

artworks.title: Ayant terminé leurs travaux ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of men with oversized heads walking together while holding branches with leaves. In the background, there are more figures carrying similar branches, with text at the top of the image reading "Souvenirs du Congres de la Paix." The style is akin to the work of an artist like Honoré Daumier, known for his caricatures. The composition uses body language and facial expressions to provide a humorous commentary on the scene.

artworks.title: La paix universelle étant décrétée ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting exaggerated figures engaged in various activities. The central figure stands with arms crossed and wears a wide-brimmed hat. Another figure is kneeling down, possibly writing or drawing on a block, wearing an exaggerated military uniform. The third figure carries a large load on their back, bent over with effort. The background shows soft outlines of an urban street with buildings on either side. The drawing likely conveys a humorous or critical commentary on social or political topics of the time. Text is included at the top and bottom of the drawing in French.

artworks.title: Le jour ou il y a une nouvelle
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a satirical assembly featuring exaggerated caricatures in a comical setting. In the upper section, a group of individuals with large heads and exaggerated facial features react to news. The lower section shows two stylized figures in discussion, with faint figures as their audience. Comic expressions, disproportionate body features, and exaggerated postures suggest a humorous take on the characters' behavior. The style likely reflects the artist's commentary on the political scene.

artworks.title: Lucien Murat et Antony Thouron ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description:
The image shows two separate illustrations. 

In the first illustration, two men stand facing each other in front of a door with a curtain. Both men have large, round bellies. The man on the left has short, dark hair and wears a dark suit with a white shirt underneath. The man on the right has a prominent mustache and holds a top hat in his left hand. Another man is partially visible behind the curtain.

In the second illustration, a man is seated at a lectern, reaching forward to place a top hat on another seated person with wild, flowing hair, obscuring their face. The seated man is depicted in formal clothing. In the background, a densely packed crowd of spectators is outlined. The style is sketchy and satirical, with exaggerated figures.

artworks.title: Quand un orateur ennuyeux est a la tribune
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a satirical assembly setting. The drawing is divided into two scenes. In one scene, figures react humorously to a speech, while an orator stands in the background. The second scene shows a heated argument with animated figures gesturing at each other. The style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier, known for caricatures and social commentary.

artworks.title: Conciliabule chez le grand homme
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of caricatures depicting scenes of discussion and reprimand within an assembly setting. The top scene shows a group huddled together around a solitary figure near a podium. The figures have exaggerated features and expressive facial expressions. In the bottom scene, two figures engage in a confrontational manner in a larger assembly hall while others watch. The drawing uses line work and shading to emphasize expressions and interactions, set against a formal background.

artworks.title: Deux phénomènes, spectacle gratis ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of caricatured figures in an assembly setting. The upper section shows exaggeratedly drawn figures wearing top hats. They are engaging with each other under the title "Deux phénomènes, spectacle gratis." The lower section depicts a scene with one figure gesturing passionately while another appears uninterested. Additional figures are sketched in the background. The lower caption reads "Taschereau dans l'exercice de ses interruptions." The illustration features fine line work using black and white for contrast and expression emphasis.

artworks.title: Séance de nuit
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a satirical depiction of an assembly. The drawing includes two scenes with exaggerated caricatures and humorous captions illustrating a parliamentary assembly after hours. 

The top scene is labeled "Séance de nuit" (Night session) and shows a dimly lit room with two exaggerated figures.

The bottom scene depicts two large figures in a hall, with a caption indicating small figures do not leave the room alone after seven o'clock in the evening.

artworks.title: Mariez-vous donc ... en chine
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures and an ornate table setting. One figure is seated, wearing an intricate gown and holding a fan. The second figure stands to the left, wearing a conical hat and a costume reminiscent of carnival attire. The scene is set indoors, with elegant furniture, drapery, and a table with a decorative vase filled with fruit and foliage. The composition suggests a theatrical or satirical tone, with exaggerated expressions and a caricature-like style.

artworks.title: L'empereur soulouque ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a large cauldron. The drawing depicts a figure holding another upside down over the cauldron. The scene is set outdoors with plants or reeds in the background. The exaggerated and cartoonish style of the characters and their actions suggest a satirical tone. The expressive faces and dynamic poses contribute to the overall sense of absurdity and mockery intended by the artist.

artworks.title: Oui, Madame Chaboulard ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two women from the waist up, engaged in conversation. The woman on the left is slightly turned towards the viewer, wearing a bonnet. Her face features fine lines suggestive of age and her hair is not visible under the bonnet. She is cloaked in a patterned shawl and holds a large, wicker basket. The woman on the right stands facing the left, her profile showing lightly aged features. Her hair is mostly hidden under a bonnet, with only her tied back hair visible at the nape. She is dressed in dark clothing, including a shawl wrapped around her shoulders, with her hands clasped together in front of her. Both women are standing near a doorway, part of which is shaded, against a background of partially visible vertical siding. The scene is depicted in a sketch or drawing style, with the top of the image labeled "ACTUALITÉS."

artworks.title: Ratapoil Fesant de la Propaganda: Si vous aimez votre femme, votre maison, votre champ, votre génisse et votre veau, signez, vous n'avez pas une minute de perdre!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men. The man on the left leans towards the other, whispering into his ear. He has elongated facial features, a long nose and chin, and wears a hat, long overcoat, and holds a walking stick. The man on the right stands with arms crossed, looking ahead with a furrowed brow. He has short hair under a cap, a vest, a shirt with rolled-up sleeves, and loose-fitting pants. In the background, sketched lines suggest a rustic outdoor setting near a wooden structure. The scene is framed by text and newspaper-like elements.

artworks.title: Réapparition de la jeunesse dorée en 1851
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing facing slightly toward each other. The man on the left has his eyes closed with a smug smile and long, wavy hair, while the man on the right has a wide smile with round cheeks and shorter, wavy hair. Both men wear ornate coats with wide lapels and sashes; the left man’s coat has a floral pattern, while the right man’s coat features intricate designs. They also wear tall, bicorne hats and cravats around their necks. The man on the right appears to gesture toward a symbolic statue labeled "RÉPUBLIQUE." The background is plain with no additional scenery or objects.

artworks.title: Le perroquet de M. Guizot
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a crowd of people reacting to a parrot. In the drawing, a parrot is perched on a stand with a human-like face instead of a bird head. Multiple hands are reaching towards the parrot and various figures are depicted with expressions such as surprise or excitement. The scene conveys a sense of satire or humor, potentially criticizing or mocking authority. The parrot being above the crowd could symbolize a sense of aloofness or superiority.

artworks.title: Le trois légitimistes ... revenant de Claremont
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: There are three caricatured figures walking on a road between signposts for France and England. The figures are dressed in ornate clothing with exaggerated features like large noses and pointed hats. They each carry long sticks and the leading figure appears to be guiding the group towards the France sign, while the others follow hesitantly. In the background, there are signs for "ENGLAND" and "FRANCE". The drawing is done in a comical style and includes a caption that says "The three Legitimist Pilgrims returning from Claremont."

artworks.title: Projet d'une statue ... a Odilon-Nemrod
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a caricature of a muscular male figure with exaggerated features, such as a pronounced belly and expressive face. The subject is standing on a pedestal, wearing a helmet, and holding a small pig by its hind legs in his right hand, with his left arm supporting a walking stick or club. The sculpture is monochromatic, resembling bronze as indicated by the shading and detail. The sculpture appears larger than life, with an authoritative and confident pose indicative of a heroic or mythological style, often placed in public displays associated with commemorated figures.

artworks.title: Air connu: Oh! Richard, Oh! Mon roi ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures in motion. The main scene shows three figures interacting lively, reacting to the presence of a fourth figure holding a baton. The figures are exaggerated and whimsically dressed. One figure wears a hat with the word "Univers" on it. Another figure has bulging eyes and looks apprehensive. In the background, a lone figure stands observing. The scene is sketched with detailed, expressive lines.

artworks.title: Belle dame voulez-vous ... accepter mon bras?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of two individuals. The person on the left is hunched forward, with one arm extended toward the person on the right. They have exaggerated facial features, including a prominent nose and chin, and are wearing a dark, textured suit and hat. The person on the right is standing upright, turning their head away from the person on the left. They have simpler, more classical facial features, with dark hair pulled back into a bun. Their clothing is draped and flowing, and they hold a large scroll labeled "République Française." The background is plain, with no additional details.

artworks.title: Bas-relief en pain d'épices ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a bas-relief depicting a procession. The artwork shows stylized figures in a ceremonial setting, including figures on horseback with exaggerated features. The central figure holds a baton or stick, while another figure carries a drum. There are cloud-like elements above. The style is reminiscent of caricature or satire, emphasizing facial and body features with distinct lines and contours.

artworks.title: Rêvant qu'elle a gagné le gros lingot d'or.
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a sleeping woman dreaming. The image shows a person sleeping in a bed on the left side, surrounded by heavy bed curtains. Above the sleeper's head is a bubble-like dream scene that includes a grand estate with a mansion in the background, a coach with a driver, and horses in the foreground. The driver appears to be joyfully handling the reins, and the horses are depicted in motion. The dreamlike quality is emphasized by the cloud-like shape containing the estate and the carriage, contrasting with the more solid and detailed rendering of the bedroom on the left. The drawing style is reminiscent of the work by Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Vue prise dans la salle des pas perdus ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a corridor setting. The figures are depicted in a cartoonish manner, with exaggerated facial features and postures. They stand or walk with hunched backs and elongated heads, engaging in various expressions. The scene is detailed with shading, capturing a sense of depth and providing a lively yet somber atmosphere. The drawing appears to be done using soft pencil or charcoal.

artworks.title: Le triomphe de la loi du 31 Mai
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of caricatured figures carrying a larger figure labeled "LOI DU 31 MAI" on its hat. The dominant figure being carried is oversized, with a protruding belly and a disgruntled expression. The figures beneath are exaggerated in their features and are hunched under the weight. They are dressed in formal or government attire. This image uses satire to comment on the perceived difficulty of maintaining a specific law or decree, evident from the expressions of the carrying figures.

artworks.title: Athalie
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing close together. The person on the left has a beard and curly hair, looking surprised. The middle individual has a hood and short dark hair, looking dramatic with raised hands. The person on the right has a bald head, long facial hair, and a surprised expression. All three wear loose, robe-like garments. The background is dark and neutral.
